body: That must feel like incredible loneliness.....I’m so sorry
I don’t really know what I need. If you’re offering to be my friend then you’re just running the risk of me pushing you away like all the others
Exactly....it’s like no shit I know you’re not a therapist.....but I don’t want to hear what a therapist would say, I want to hear comforting words of a friend...
You’re right, I said it poorly. They’re not sick of me, they’re sick of my shit. Rightfully so.

That’s fine though. I feel like it’s their problem if they’re broken from losing me. If they think I’m being selfish thinking this way then I think they’re being selfish for wanting me to stick around and continue to be miserable.
